title: My Home and My Cat
text:
My house is small and blue. It has two windows and a red door. The kitchen is big. There is a table with four chairs in it.

My cat is named Luna. She is black and white. She has long ears and green eyes. She likes to sleep on the sofa.

questions.text: What is the name of the cat?
What can you infer about the writer's home?
options: It is a very large house with many rooms
It is a small home with bright colors
It is far away from the city
It has no windows at all

questions.text: What can you infer about Luna from the passage?
options: She likes to rest and relax
She does not like the sofa

vocabulary.definition: openings in a wall that let in light and air
the room where food is prepared
a long, soft seat for several people

paragraph_translations: Mi casa es pequeña y azul. Tiene dos ventanas y una puerta roja. La cocina es grande. Hay una mesa con cuatro sillas en ella.
Mi gato se llama Luna. Ella es negra y blanca. Tiene orejas largas y ojos verdes. Le gusta dormir en el sofá.
